subject.title: Feature Request: Image batching / media group buffering at gateway layer

question: Should LINE-style channels without native grouping metadata get opt-in same-sender media batching, a broader shared channel batching contract, or no heuristic media batching support?
rationale: LINE has no reliable album id, and automation should not choose the default latency, grouping key, flush-on-text behavior, or plugin-versus-core ownership for a public config change.

options.title: Add LINE opt-in batching
options.body: Add a conservative LINE plugin config key and batch only same-account, same-conversation, same-sender downloadable media with documented latency and reply-token tradeoffs.

options.title: Design shared contract first
options.body: Define a media-aware channel SDK/core batching contract before changing LINE, accepting broader architecture and compatibility review.

options.title: Keep heuristics unsupported
options.body: Keep native Telegram album buffering only and document that channels without grouping metadata dispatch media events individually.

recommendation.title: Add LINE opt-in batching
recommendation.body: Add a conservative LINE plugin config key and batch only same-account, same-conversation, same-sender downloadable media with documented latency and reply-token tradeoffs.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision is primarily about shared inbound semantics and public config/product policy, where the shared debounce history points most strongly to this owner.
